detailed_descriptions.en: Enjoy a colony simulator without the steep learning curve. Simply place resources, sit back, and observe. The Teno are a volatile alien species, capable of fusing intelligently with their environment, or exploding into a pile of bones. As you learn about them, you use this information to grow their colony, unlocking new resources and uncovering more advanced behaviours. Investigate the extent of the aliens' intelligence, and find ways to make use of their volatility. Enjoy a hand-crafted retro pixel art aesthetic, a lo-fi sci-fi soundtrack, and tonnes of weird little guys. Full game features: 20 Teno variants 10 Placeable resources 4 Biomes 7 Hivemind Idea-Viruses (if you don't know what this means, don't worry about it!) 100+ Alien behaviours A resolution to the Teno's story 2 post-game Sandbox modes Achievements This is a small project by a solo developer, and NO generative AI was used whatsoever.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Enjoy a colony simulator without the steep learning curve. Simply place resources, sit back, and observe.

The Teno are a volatile alien species, capable of fusing intelligently with their environment, or exploding into a pile of bones. As you learn about them, you use this information to grow their colony, unlocking new resources and uncovering more advanced behaviours. 

Investigate the extent of the aliens' intelligence, and find ways to make use of their volatility.

Enjoy a hand-crafted retro pixel art aesthetic, a lo-fi sci-fi soundtrack, and tonnes of weird little guys. 

Full game features:

  • 20 Teno variants

  • 10 Placeable resources

  • 4 Biomes

  • 7 Hivemind Idea-Viruses (if you don't know what this means, don't worry about it!)

  • 100+ Alien behaviours

  • A resolution to the Teno's story

  • 2 post-game Sandbox modes

  • Achievements

This is a small project by a solo developer, and NO generative AI was used whatsoever.
